name: Tahm Kench
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand. Level up: I've Captured 3+ units. When I level up, Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.

name: Go Hard
text: Drain 1 from a unit. Create 2 copies of Go Hard in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me everywhere into Pack Your Bags.

name: Eye of the Ra-Horak
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. Countdown 1: Stun the 2 weakest enemies. Daybreak: Summon a copy of me with Countdown 2.

name: Ornn
text: Keywords: Tough. Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand. Attack: Forge me twice. Level up: An ally has struck for 8+ damage in one strike.

name: Sacrificial Scholar
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me.

name: Frozen Tomb
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. Countdown 2: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.

name: Children of the Forest (created)
text: Keywords: Fast. Summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.
